pageProps.title: The Moving Finger
pageProps.review: A review of Agatha Christie's Miss Marple series novel, which keenly insightfully explores human malice that destroys ordinariness through anonymous letters and the gossip culture of modern society.
pageProps.description: In a small country village, a single letter spreads distrust and murder. The finger has already moved
pageProps.content:
## Review It is a work that excellently depicts the power to destroy ordinariness through the ```anonymous tool``` of letters. It's a book containing keen insights that touch upon gossip and anonymous accusation culture, which are also problems in modern society. With the development of communication, these problems must have become even more vicious and despicable compared to the past.
It still leaves a deep lingering impression.
```Miss Marple``` appears in this book.
